text: The evidence does not confirm whether the 2025 clearing of native forest on this property was illegal under Uruguayan law. While the data shows a 13.5-hectare tree-cover loss in 2025, it does not establish whether the change was persistent, the cause of the loss, or whether it was authorized. The observations confirm the presence of native forest before the event, but legal status requires additional context not provided here, such as permits or compliance with Uruguay’s forest protection regulations. Further investigation is needed to determine legality.
